plain: A written copy of something, such as spoken words in a court case

webster.text: A copy; a writing made from and according to an original; a writing or composition consisting of the same words with the original.

example.quote: Every Inhabitant of the Countrie shall have free libertie to search and veewe any Rooles, Records, or Regesters of any Court or office except the Councell, And to have a transcript or exemplification thereof written examined, and signed by the hand of the officer of the office paying the appointed fees therefore.
